newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Just Jeans says pressures continue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Just Jeans says pressures continue.

text.p: Clothing retailer Just Jeans Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that competitive pressures on retailing continue unabated, although the state of the economy augured well for a turnaround in consumer sentiment.

Managing director Peter Wilkinson said in the annual report that people were spending less of their disposable income on clothing and this is unlikely to increase significantly for some time. Continued shopping centre growth and refurbishments had also led to an unsustainable increase in selling space and an over-supply of retail outlets, he said.

"On the positive side, recent falls in interest rates and continued indications of benign inflation and wage environment augur well for sustainable economic growth in the future and, we expect, a turnaround in consumer sentiment," Wilkinson said.

He said management was paying special attention to positioning strategies to ensure its three businesses -- Just Jeans, Jay Jay's Trademark and Jacqui E -- focus on specific markets, and to minimise overlap and cross-shopping.
Just Jeans reported a net profit of A$14.11 million for the year to July 27, up from A$12.65 million a year earlier. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
